clarified_intent.description: Validate and refine the entity-inspection implementation, public documentation, skills/API ledgers, shared fixture, security note, and assembled acceptance receipt for truthful archive readiness.

constraints: The public ./devtools export ledger must match the built runtime without changing the root runtime export set.
Documentation must distinguish canonical originals, local patches, merged live values, view membership, schema-derived relationships, and preview conflict semantics exactly.
Metadata-only behavior and the remaining identifier/topology exposure must be stated without implying anonymity or transport authorization.
Every behavioral claim must trace to the retained assembled packed-consumer receipt and byte-identical fixture sources.
The artifact must not claim completion of downstream time travel, React/Flutter UI, extension, site, or release work.

target_state.description: A schema-valid, deterministic QA packet with zero blocking constraint failures and exact evidence/scope traceability.
success_criteria: The built ./devtools runtime export names equal the committed core ledger.
The acceptance receipt contains only pass statuses across package, consumers, fixture, and 13 scenarios.
The core and Flutter fixtures are byte-identical at the receipt SHA-256.
README, skills reference, API table, changelog, and security receipt match production semantics.
No downstream DevTools or publication completion claim appears.

unknowns: The later time-travel and UI changes may extend the protocol; this artifact certifies only entity inspection.
